selection_note: Evidence-led London DJ opportunities for a house DJ seeking first public sets. Central London was searched first; the radius was widened to near-central East London where current open-decks activity is concentrated.
safety_note: Equipment is marked confirmed only when an organiser or venue publishes it. Contact routes are provided for manual outreach only; no messages have been sent.

opportunities.venue: Bread and Butter Arch / Faded Community
opportunities.genres: House, techno, breaks, electro, minimal and garage
opportunities.opportunity: Open means open. Anyone can register on arrival; 20-minute slots are allocated by random draw.
opportunities.equipment: Pioneer XDJ-XZ all-in-one with Pioneer XDJ-700. Bring a Rekordbox-formatted USB and headphones; no laptops.
opportunities.evidence_note: Current Eventbrite listing and official Faded page explicitly invite bedroom and experienced DJs and publish the equipment.
opportunities.next_action: Reserve the current event, prepare a 20-minute Rekordbox playlist and arrive early for the draw.
opportunities.constraint: This is a random draw, so a slot is not guaranteed.

opportunities.genres: Electronic, house, club and eclectic DJ programming
opportunities.opportunity: The official site actively invites proposals for music, DJs, launch nights and residencies. Offer a no-fee warm-up set or trial house residency.
opportunities.equipment: Downstairs: 2× Pioneer CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-900NXS2 and 2× Technics 1210s. Ground floor: 2× CDJ-900NXS, DJM-750MK2 and 2× PLX-1000.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official hire and information pages explicitly ask for DJ, night and residency enquiries; the official 2026 technical specification publishes both booths.
opportunities.next_action: Send a short tailored pitch with one 30-minute house mix and offer an early or quiet-night trial set.
opportunities.constraint: Curated venue. A specific night concept and mix will outperform a generic request.

opportunities.genres: All genres; house and electronic welcome
opportunities.opportunity: The organiser says the open-decks session is open to all DJs and all genres at BOXPARK Shoreditch BEATBOX.
opportunities.equipment: Venue DJ setup is supplied for the open-decks event; exact player and mixer models are not published. Confirm USB/headphone requirements before attending.
opportunities.contact_name: BOXPARK Shoreditch / On The Rise DJ Academy
opportunities.evidence_note: Current organiser listing dated 27 October 2026 invites all DJs to play and describes the event as a platform for fresh talent.
opportunities.next_action: Register for the free open-decks portion, confirm the equipment and prepare a concise house set.
opportunities.constraint: The preceding workshop is paid; the 18:00-22:00 open-decks session is advertised separately as free.

opportunities.genres: Open format; electronic and house suitable
opportunities.opportunity: LVLS advertises a free open-decks night inviting DJs to spin or attend. Frames & Frequency also runs a monthly all-experience open-decks series at the same venue.
opportunities.equipment: An in-house open-decks setup is available; exact deck and mixer models are not published.
opportunities.evidence_note: Current free event listing for 22 October 2026 plus a monthly Open Frequencies series explicitly open to DJs of all experience levels.
opportunities.next_action: Reserve a place and message the organiser to confirm signup timing and USB format.
opportunities.constraint: Outside Central London, included because the current opportunity is unusually accessible.

opportunities.schedule: Every Thursday from 19:00; next evidenced date 22 October 2026
opportunities.genres: All styles; house and lighter techno explicitly welcome
opportunities.opportunity: Weekly first-come, first-served 30-minute open-decks slots for DJs of all abilities.
opportunities.equipment: 2× Technics 1210 turntables. Vinyl only; bring your own records.
opportunities.evidence_note: Current recurring listing states weekly Thursday slots, all abilities and genres, and names the Technics 1210 setup.
opportunities.next_action: Use only if you can prepare a vinyl house set; arrive before 19:00 for signup.
opportunities.constraint: Vinyl-only, so not suitable for a USB-only set.

opportunities.schedule: Monthly; next date not yet published
opportunities.genres: Eclectic selectors with regular house programming
opportunities.opportunity: Official monthly On Wax event showcases upcoming London DJ talent; the in-house team curates new DJs.
opportunities.equipment: Bespoke hand-built DJ booth and Klipsch/Tannoy hybrid sound system. On Wax is vinyl-only; turntable models are not published.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official venue page calls On Wax a monthly vinyl open-decks evening for upcoming talent and says it regularly finds guest DJs.
opportunities.next_action: Email a concise vinyl-house pitch and ask how the in-house team accepts selections for the next On Wax lineup.

opportunities.genres: Late-night global dance and electronic programming
opportunities.opportunity: The independent venue invites partnership enquiries and runs late-night Friday and Saturday music programming.
opportunities.equipment: No public DJ technical specification verified. Ask before pitching a USB-only set.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official contact page invites partnership opportunities; no current open-decks call was found.
opportunities.next_action: Monitor the programme and pitch only when a house-compatible night appears.
opportunities.constraint: Not an active DJ call; lower-confidence outreach route.

opportunities.genres: House, deep house, tech house and electronic
opportunities.opportunity: The venue hosts promoter-led house nights. The realistic route is to approach a compatible promoter for an opening set, not request a headline booking from the club.
opportunities.equipment: Venue has a working club booth, but exact equipment could not be verified from an accessible official specification.
opportunities.evidence_note: Recent programme evidence shows deep, tech, Afro and soulful house events; no current beginner submission route was verified.
opportunities.next_action: Identify two upcoming house promoters on the venue calendar and pitch a free warm-up set with a matching mix.
opportunities.constraint: Promoter relationship required; monitor rather than cold-emailing the venue blindly.

opportunities.schedule: House/techno/trance free party listed for 24 October 2026
opportunities.opportunity: Strong genre fit and active programming, but no public beginner or unsolicited-DJ submission route was found.
opportunities.equipment: Official venue materials describe a professional event setup; exact DJ equipment was not verified for an unsolicited set.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official 2026 calendar includes active electronic and house/techno/trance programming, but this is not an open call.
opportunities.next_action: Attend compatible free parties and build promoter relationships; do not make this a first cold outreach target.
